title: The Missing Passport
scene: At 7:55 AM, a passport vanished from the gate desk. The gate area was sealed during a drill from 7:40 to 8:20.

suspects.name: Ada Reed
suspects.testimony: I was at the gate desk at 7:55, checking boarding passes.
suspects.alibiProof: The gate camera shows Ada at 7:53 and 7:58.

suspects.name: Bruno Pike
suspects.testimony: I was in the lounge at 7:55.
suspects.alibiProof: The lounge camera shows Bruno at 7:51 and 8:01.

suspects.name: Celia Vale
suspects.testimony: I was at the podium at 7:55.
suspects.alibiProof: The podium log shows Celia's badge at 7:54.

suspects.name: Dario Ash
suspects.testimony: I was behind the desk at 7:55, printing a ticket.
suspects.contradiction: The gate was sealed at 7:40, and passport foil was in Dario's wallet.
